name: Omega^Q_up smeared k = 2 continuum de-shift weight (Q3-full-delta0.2 psi2)
identity: W[chi](t) := int_0^oo chi(nu) [R_-(nu) cos((nu+i)t) + R_+(nu) cos((nu-i)t)] dnu = Phi(t) := int_0^oo psi(nu) cos(nu t) dnu; R_-+ = prl/data/kernels.json D_k2_EE; X = chi (R_- + R_+) is the weight in the convention of d_abel_X_*.txt
form: chi(nu) = chi_re(nu) + i chi_im(nu); each part = Q(nu) sum_k x_k [g_k(nu - c_k) + g_k(nu + c_k)] + sum_{j=0}^{2} y_j nu^(2j) l(nu) exp(-nu^2/2), Q(nu) = nu^2/(nu^2 + 1/4)^2, g_k(z) = exp(-z^2/(2 sigma_k^2)) (only g(nu) for c_k = 0), l(nu) = (nu^2+1) log(nu^2+1) (principal branch)
singularities: poles of order 2 at nu = +-i/2 (double zeros of R_-/R_+ in the crossed strips); branch points at +-i (they carry the |mu| kink of psi); double zero at 0 (cancels the 1/nu poles of R_-+); analytic in |Im nu| < 1 otherwise; super-Gaussian decay beyond nu ~ Lam + 30
certificate: for all t >= 0: |W[chi_re](t) - Phi(t)| <= eps_W_re, |W[chi_im](t)| <= eps_W_im_null (shifted form, CERT_CLOSE.md §3.2); eps_W = int_0^oo |E(mu) - psi(mu)| dmu, E(mu) = 2 Re[chi(mu - i) R_-(mu - i)], by a 4.2e5-point quadrature in double precision (grade [DV], not interval-verified); hence |image - target| <= eps_W P_{-1/2}(cosh beta) for all beta
precision: coefficients are IEEE doubles (exact as given); double-precision evaluation of chi_re agrees with 50-digit evaluation to 6.5e-13 of max|chi_re| at nu = 0.3, 1, 5, 30, 100, 798.8, 997.5
